text:
Sam Park: quick q — as we're surfacing SLO thresholds in console, how should the notify routing policy map to per-tenant fallback tiers? e.g. if primary on-call tier is silenced, do we escalate to secondary region, or switch to lower-volume channel? Also need telemetry fields for noise estimation in UI. cc @Maria Nguyen @Cheng Li

Maria Nguyen: +1 for a policy model: primary escalation -> regional fallback -> soft-notify (digest) -> owner email. prefer not to route to lower-volume channels unless owner opt-in. :thumbsup:

Cheng Li: agree. API proposal: add notify_policy { tiers: [PRIMARY, REGIONAL, DIGEST, OWNER_EMAIL], spillover_allowed: bool, escalation_window_secs: int }

Alex Rivera: nit: spillover_allowed should be per-tier, not global. Sometimes we allow regional spillover but block public channels.

Maria Nguyen: true. Also need telemetry: 'notify_attempts', 'escalation_path', 'time_to_ack', 'suppressed_by_quiet_window'. UI needs an estimate of expected noise = p(trigger)*notify_attempts_over_24h.

Sam Park: can we show simulated weekly noise for config preview? i.e. "estimated alerts/week" with ranges. Important for tenant rollouts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New API patch pushed to staging: refs/notify-policy/allow-per-tier-flag

Zoe Patel: UX question — show simplified mode (one slider for sensitivity) and advanced mode (per-tier controls)?

Alex Rivera: simplified mode + slider maps to auto-calibrated thresholds + default routing. advanced exposes the full proto.

Maria Nguyen: implementation note: console will need normalized sampling telemetry to avoid double-counting when multiple SLOs fire. use canonical fingerprint id.

Cheng Li: I'll draft the proto and telemetry schema. want to sync tomorrow 11am.

Sam Park: SG. can you drop a small proto snippet here so QE can start mocks?

Cheng Li: sure:
```
message NotifyTier { string name = 1; bool allow_spill = 2; int32 escalation_delay_s = 3; }
message NotifyPolicy { repeated NotifyTier tiers = 1; bool allow_quiet_window_override = 2; }
```

Maria Nguyen: looks good. QE: @Zoe Patel can you mock noise estimates for the preview? start with conservative multipliers x1.5.

Zoe Patel: on it, will have mock charts by EOD.
